latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of Caption Generator From Photo — Turn Photos Into Captioned Videos.

- Instantly generate AI captions for uploaded photos, with overlays rendered as 1080p MP4 videos in 20–40 seconds.
- Supports JPG, PNG, WEBP, and HEIC uploads up to 200MB; ideal for content creators needing fast captioned videos.
- Handles authentication automatically with free credits — no account required.
- Clear user guidance for uploading, generating captions, exporting, and checking credits or status.
- Cloud GPU rendering pipeline with detailed error handling and status feedback.
- Workflow tips and endpoint mapping included for smooth use.
